LESSON: ENTERPRISE PROJECT AT SCHOOL

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Economic Activities
Topic 4.3: Enterprise Project at School
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Enterprise Project at School, part of Economic Activities in Grade 4 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How are enterprise projects managed in school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the projects that can be initiated at school,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Enterprise Project at School in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. participate in initiating an enterprise project at school,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Enterprise Project at School in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. uphold ethics and collective efforts in managing enterprise projects at school.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Enterprise Project at School in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify the projects that can be initiated at school,

   Enterprise Project at School helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. participate in initiating an enterprise project at school,

C. uphold ethics and collective efforts in managing enterprise projects at school.

   Enterprise Project at School helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

3. design personal protective equipment for safety on the roads using locally available materials,
4. participate in the initiation and management of the enterprise project in the school,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Enterprise Project at School together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Learners share responsibilities on the planned enterprise

● Creativity and imagination: Learners identify a viable project enterprise at school

Values:
● Responsibility: Learners engage in the assigned roles and duties as they undertake the enterprise project at school and

evaluate its success

● Integrity: Learners develop accountability as they participate in the initiation and management of the enterprise project

in the school
